newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean cen. bank asks to help Kia subcontractors.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean cen. bank asks to help Kia subcontractors.

text.p: South Korea's central bank's Office of Bank Supervision on Friday asked financial institutions to support the ailing Kia Group's subcontractors to prevent a string of defaults following Kia's financial woes.

"To minimise shock to the economy and society from the bail-out of Kia affiliates and to accelerate the normalisation of Kia's operations, the Office of Bank Supervision requested the support of financial institutions for Kia's subcontractors," said a statement by the Bank of Korea.

The central bank suggested that financial institutions refrain from pressing subcontractors to buy back discounted Kia promissory notes, discount Kia's promissory notes and extend loans to the subcontractors, the statement said.
It said the move was to facilitate fund raising for Kia subcontracting companies holding promissory notes and prevent a domino effect of defaults.
Kia Group's financial crisis deepened when creditor banks pledged on Tuesday to protect Kia from imminent failure and has rocked the local financial industry.
Kia Motors Corp and 17 other units of the group have been designated by creditor banks for bail-out.
